question: What concrete choices connected participation, access and shared recognition at Dhwani?

original_sources.inspection: Coordinator and separate researcher/reviewer visually read both complete original pages. Organiser report supports the completed 21–22 March 2023 festival in Bhubaneswar, disabled attendees, screenings and discussion. No exact film or audience total adopted.

original_sources.locator: PDF page 2, section 4; PDF page 3, Mandate
original_sources.inspection: Coordinator visually read original pages 2–3; separate reviewer inspected all four pages. English subtitles required. Half of prize money specified when the main role is played by a person with a disability; actual transfers not established.

adoption: One concise paragraph in Futures, between NFAI institutional access and BYOFF community support. Preserve images and all other prose.
source_gate: Separate reviewer inspected originalpages and passed claimscope; advised removing a redundant closing sentence, adopted.
limits: Organiser account of an event is not an independent outcome evaluation.
Required subtitles do not establish delivered or universally accessible screenings; no audio description, sign-language or venue-access claim.
Prize-share mandate is conditional; no actual payment, ordinary wage or copyright royalty inferred.
No disability identity inferred for filmmakers, speakers or people in photographs.
No film-language, audience transformation, employment or wider distribution success inferred.

additional_context_not_adopted.finding: Current page concerns 2025. Script-support offer is conditional on filmmaker choice and completion; no completed project or current application availability inferred.
Chairman Jitendra Kumar Biswal describes aspirations and future grassroots screenings; reported 45 entries not adopted. No completed outreach claim.
Indexed 2025 count framing differs from entries in TNIE; not adopted or adjudicated.

access_notes: Initial public curl failed DNS; authorised external retrieval downloaded the original rules PDF.
Researcher web PDF screenshot cache miss; local original render resolved visual inspection.
Arundhati Foundation direct 406 recorded by researcher; no bypass or substantive claim.

next_leads.question: Did a named script actually receive the advertised BPFTIO production support and become a completed film?
next_leads.source: Dhwani 2023 rules, PDF page 4, and 2025 official page
next_leads.requirement: Named completed work, credits or delivery report; a conditional offer alone is insufficient.

next_leads.question: How did participants describe the screening experience and its access features?
next_leads.requirement: Inspectable participant account or concrete event access record; no outcome inference from announced requirements.

adopted_text: At the 2023 Dhwani festival in Bhubaneswar, people with disabilities joined other viewers for screenings and discussion. Its rules required English subtitles and provided for half of any prize money to go to a disabled performer playing the main role.
